source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Press "+/-" to change options

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: this case exercises the BIOS setup function "Change Opt." (the Change Value/Option key) in the POST General Hotkey context; an interactive keyboard action inside the pre-OS setup menu. Agent cannot send keystrokes to the BIOS setup over SSH.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator performs the Change Value/Option key in BIOS setup and confirms the menu response; agent cannot drive the BIOS setup UI.
deepseek_columns.remark: same code in 2 workbook rows (multi-row code)

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly identifies the pre-OS interactive core.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds exact option, expected transition and restoration controls.

original_test_intent: Verify that the BIOS setup plus/minus keys change an approved selected option through the expected displayed values.
original_method: Enter the intended pre-OS setup page, visually record the initial value, press the platform-mapped + and - keys, observe each value transition, and restore or explicitly approve the final state.
manual_activity: A human must select the named BIOS option, actuate the mapped + and - keys, visually judge the value changes, and control whether the setting is restored or saved.
required_inputs: Exact BIOS page/option and initial value
Expected + and - transition sequence and key mapping
safety_requirements: Do not alter boot, storage, security, thermal or power behavior outside the approved plan.
Restore the original value unless saving is explicitly approved.
Stop on unexpected transition or inability to restore.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the option/value matrix and evidence checklist.
Collect read-only platform and log context where available.
Analyze supplied screen evidence and report differences without issuing a verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact option and final-state policy.
Operate and observe the BIOS UI.
Restore or approve the final value, verify recovery, and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly declines an SSH substitute; no OS command proves the interactive +/- behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the interactive BIOS method; an approved remote KVM may carry the same human action and visual evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: +/-, option change, 30-minute attended time and 30-minute machine time are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use timestamped continuous capture of the selected field, both key actions, each displayed transition, restoration/save choice and safe exit.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Board and BIOS build after option/key-map confirmation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC and console firmware versions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a concrete non-critical target, reversible state control and traceable evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; remote KVM is acceptable only when it preserves the same interaction and observation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Option map and approved value sequence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An unspecified field can change platform behavior.

project_override_considerations: A project may choose the safe option and approved value sequence, but must record the original and final values and cannot replace the key-function test with an OS inventory query.
expected_evidence: Initial value and highlighted field capture
Normal boot/log recovery and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The primary row consistently requests +/- option changes. Code reuse and missing project-specific option values are identity/readiness issues, not an internal source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The test intent is clear and manual; absent option, console or restoration inputs defer execution rather than making the library case permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees that the pre-OS action is not SSH-runnable.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its case-specific state-change safeguards but permits validated remote KVM instead of requiring physical presence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Locks duplicate-code identity and separates manual execution readiness from the engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Defines a reversible option-transition contract and prevents the later same-code release-note case from contaminating this variant.
independent_technical_reasoning: The acceptance condition is the visible response of a BIOS field to human key input. Preparation and post-boot checks may be automated, but neither replaces the interactive core, so MANUAL ONLY is required.

source_provenance.history: Repository exact-code search and duplicate row 1455 comparison

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat key presses or save an unexpected value automatically; stop, preserve the displayed state and obtain engineer direction.
